email.subject: Order PO 20993 - Edmonton to Kelowna
email.body:
Hi,

We need a truck for the below. Weights are in kgs, sorry, our system is metric.

Pickup: Northern Lights Beverages, 12220 160 St NW, Edmonton AB T5V 1H5, Mon Nov 23, 10:00
Delivery: Okanagan Liquor Depot, 1050 Ellis St, Kelowna BC V1Y 1Z5, Tue Nov 24 before 16:00

22 pallets bottled water, 12,000 kgs

We'll pay $2,800 CAD.

Theo Brandt
Northern Lights Beverages
